commits.subject: Skip Redis-backed batch discard on Redisson 4.8.0
Skip Redis-backed batch discard on Redisson 4.8.0

diagnoses.analysis: This is the aggregate required-status gate, not an independent compilation or test failure. The frozen workflow .github/workflows/reusable-pr-build.yml:62-76 depends on test-latest-deps and deliberately exits 1 when that dependency fails. The frozen testLatestDeps0 failure is the atomicBatchDiscard failure diagnosed below. Extending the existing exclusion to the confirmed-broken Redisson 4.8.0 runtime addresses that dependency without weakening the aggregate gate.

The PR-added atomicBatchDiscard test fails on the pinned latest Redisson 4.8.0 runtime. It excludes only 4.7.0, although the published 4.8.0 sources retain the identical upstream defect: discardAsync sends DISCARD while aggregatedCommands remains Collections.emptyMap(), and RedisQueuedBatchExecutor.execute calls computeIfAbsent on that immutable map. The native candidate adds 4.8.0 to the existing version-specific assumption and updates its explanatory comment. It does not alter instrumentation, dependency versions, the in-memory discard test, or other supported-runtime coverage. Focused baseline checks and unit suites passed, and the exact version predicate was verified against real 3.17.0, 4.7.0 and 4.8.0 jars. Latest-mode Gradle configuration was blocked by an unrelated Java 27 provisioning certificate failure; Docker-backed integration execution is unavailable in this environment.

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

metadata.body: Represent atomic Redisson batches as one logical CLIENT span under stable database semantic conventions. The instrumentation captures queued user commands, derives sanitized operation and batch attributes, spans the overall batch result, and suppresses fragmented MULTI/command/EXEC protocol spans across supported Redisson versions. Ordinary pipeline telemetry remains unchanged, and user callbacks retain the application context instead of intermittently inheriting the internal logical batch span.
metadata.title: Add logical spans for Redisson atomic batches
